caveat: A 99.3% step drop is not a behaviour, it is almost certainly a measurement problem: the CHECKLIST events are likely partly instrumented, renamed, or firing only on a path most partners never take. Confirm the event definitions before anyone treats this as a finding — an uninstrumented step returns zero, which reads identically to nobody completing it. No qual supports a cliff here.
source: PostHog saved funnel: Branded signup funnel prod, read live 2026-10-13
statement: The onboarding checklist looks like it loses almost everyone, but the drop is too steep to believe — 17,695 submit the business model step and 125 the next one.
